crossRefs.note: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus, which struck him. He said, “Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped…
No one thinks, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, “I have burned part of it in the fire. Yes, I have…
“You shall have no other gods before me.
But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their…
You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them…
They left their images there; and David and his men took them away.

people.name: Amaziah
people.line: King of Judah, son of Joash

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Seir
people.line: Region inhabited by Edomites, descendants of Esau

translations.web: Now after Amaziah had come from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense to them.
translations.bsb: When Amaziah returned from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the Seirites, set them up as his own gods, bowed before them, and burned sacrifices to them.
translations.kjv: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.
translations.asv: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.
